# Jenna Ammerall — Senior Product Designer

> Making products make sense. As a senior product designer with nine years at
> Microsoft and Meta, Jenna gets to the root of the problem, defines the behaviors,
> and builds the frameworks teams need to carry those decisions across
> products—so everything moves as one. Seattle-based. Focus areas: interaction design,
> product behavior, product strategy, visual craft, and cross-product experience.
> Site: https://ammerallj.design/

Contact: ammerallj@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/ammerallj/

## Selected work

- Creating Continuity Across Messaging

- Shaping Accessibility Across Products

- Giving Components an Identity

- Helping People Navigate Communities

## About

- [Homepage and About](https://ammerallj.design/): Career story, design toolkit, and contact.

Design toolkit — Design & build: Figma / Make, Claude / Code, React, GitHub. Problem framing: briefs, audits, gap analysis, requirements. Research & validation: qualitative research, usability testing, experimentation, product metrics. Delivery & scale: scenario prototypes, tradeoffs, workback plans, design QA, frameworks, reusable patterns.
